verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork's scheduled tasks let a user describe a task once and have Claude run it automatically on a recurring basis, delivering finished outputs without supervision. Cowork also lets users step away while multi-step work completes. Claude Code hooks add deterministic automated actions at lifecycle points. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled tasks run reliably unattended, and documentation of background-execution constraints such as whether the app must stay open or what the run limits are.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
